title: Manali Tour Package
overview: Four days in Manali and nothing else — all three nights in one hotel, so you unpack once. A full day for the town itself (Hadimba, Manu Temple, Vashisht, Old Manali) and a full day for the mountains (Solang Valley, then through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul). Driven door to door from Delhi by private cab, with the Kullu valley on the way back. Short enough for a long weekend, and the shortest trip from Delhi that still leaves you two clear days on the ground.
highlights: All 3 nights in Manali — one hotel, no packing and moving mid-trip
Solang Valley, then the 9.02 km Atal Tunnel through to Sissu in Lahaul
Hadimba Devi Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht hot springs and Van Vihar
Evenings free on Mall Road and in Old Manali
Private cab from Delhi and back, with fuel, tolls and parking included
Daily breakfast and dinner at the hotel
Kullu valley and optional shawl shopping on the return drive
inclusions: Daily breakfast and dinner at the hotel
Private cab for the full trip and all sightseeing, Delhi to Delhi
Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel and Sissu excursion
Driver charges, fuel, and all toll and parking charges
Travel assistance on WhatsApp for the length of the trip
exclusions: Lunch and any premium meal plan
Adventure activity charges at Solang (paragliding, zorbing, ropeway, snow activities)
Entry tickets at monuments and viewpoints
Rohtang Pass NGT permit and taxi, if opted for
Room service, shopping and personal expenses
Anything not specifically listed under inclusions

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali, arrival and Mall Road
itinerary.description: Depart Delhi by private cab for the drive up through the Kullu valley along the Beas. Check in, rest, and head out in the evening to Mall Road. It is a long drive — roughly 12 to 14 hours — so the day is deliberately left free after check-in.
itinerary.morningActivity: Private cab from Delhi through the Kullu valley
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check in and evening on Mall Road

itinerary.title: Manali local — Hadimba, Vashisht and Old Manali
itinerary.description: The 1553 wooden Hadimba Devi Temple in its cedar forest, Manu Temple, the hot sulphur springs at Vashisht, and the Van Vihar walk by the Beas. The afternoon and evening go to Old Manali and its cafés above the river.
itinerary.morningActivity: Hadimba Devi Temple, Manu Temple and Van Vihar

itinerary.title: Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel to Sissu
itinerary.description: Out to Solang Valley first, then through the 9.02 km Atal Tunnel into Lahaul — a completely different, barer landscape on the far side — as far as Sissu and its waterfall. Back to Manali by evening.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Atal Tunnel to Sissu, Lahaul valley
itinerary.insiderTip: The Atal Tunnel stays open through most of the winter, unlike Rohtang. If snow is what you came for and the pass is shut, this is the day that delivers it.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi via Kullu
itinerary.description: Breakfast, check out, and the drive back down through the Kullu valley with time for shawl shopping on the way. The tour ends on arrival in Delhi.
itinerary.morningActivity: Check out and begin the return drive
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Kullu valley, with optional shawl shopping

seoDescription: Discover the best Manali tour packages with Safar Trails. Comfortable stays, private cab from Delhi, Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel through to Sissu.

faqs.question: What is the difference between this and your Shimla Manali Kasol package?
faqs.answer: This one is Manali and nothing else — 4 days, all three nights in one Manali hotel, a day for the town and a day for Solang and the Atal Tunnel. The 7-day Shimla Manali Kasol package covers three towns with two nights in each, so you see more of Himachal but less of Manali, and it costs more because it is three days longer. Pick this if Manali is the point, that one if you want the circuit.

faqs.question: Manali tour package from Delhi — what does it include?
faqs.answer: It picks you up in Delhi and drops you back at the end, so the road journey both ways is already part of it. Travel is by private AC cab with a mountain driver, and fuel, tolls, parking and the driver's allowances are included, along with 3 nights in Manali with breakfast and dinner. Pickup from Chandigarh works too and takes three to four hours off each end. If you would rather come by Volvo bus and start the tour in Manali, we can quote that version instead.

faqs.question: Manali tour package for family — is this one suitable?
faqs.answer: Yes — and staying put in one hotel for all three nights is what makes it work with children or elderly parents. There is no packing and moving mid-trip, the sightseeing sits in two easy days, and the hotel is a base to come back to rather than somewhere you are only sleeping. Tell us who is travelling and we will pick a hotel with easier access and keep the Solang day unhurried.

faqs.question: Manali tour package for couple — does it work for a honeymoon?
faqs.answer: It is one of the shortest honeymoons you can take from Delhi, which is why couples pick it when leave is tight. Transport is a private cab rather than a shared coach, and room decoration, a candlelight dinner or an upgrade to a premium or orchard-side room can be arranged — just ask when you enquire, since it depends on the hotel.

faqs.question: Manali tour package with flight — can you arrange that?
faqs.answer: This package is priced without airfare, because most travellers on it drive up from Delhi or Chandigarh. If you would prefer to fly, we can quote a version with tickets to Bhuntar (Kullu) or Chandigarh plus the road transfer to Manali. Bhuntar is much closer but its flights are weather-dependent in winter, so between December and February we usually plan Chandigarh with a road leg instead.

faqs.question: Manali tour package for a single person — can a solo traveller book it?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we will customise it rather than sell you a group seat. A solo booking is quoted on single occupancy, so the per-person price differs from the twin-sharing rate shown here — the room is the main reason, and a private cab for one is the other. A smaller vehicle or a simpler hotel brings it down. Tell us your budget and we will build to it.

faqs.question: Manali tour package 2 days 1 night — do you have one?
faqs.answer: We can arrange one, but be clear about what it is. Manali is roughly 12 to 14 hours by road from Delhi, so a 2-day plan is two nights in a vehicle and about half a day on the ground. Starting from Chandigarh makes it more realistic. This 4-day version exists because it is the shortest trip from Delhi that still gives you two clear days in Manali rather than one rushed morning.

faqs.question: Manali tour package for friends — is this a good group trip?
faqs.answer: Yes. Solang covers paragliding, zorbing and the ropeway, and the Atal Tunnel drive into Lahaul is the part most groups remember. Adventure activities are paid to the operators on the spot rather than bundled in, so you only pay for what your group actually does. For six or more we switch to a tempo traveller, which usually lowers the per-head cost.

faqs.question: Manali tour package under ₹5,000 — do you have one?
faqs.answer: Not honestly, and we would rather say so than take the enquiry. ₹5,000 a head does not cover 3 nights, a private cab from Delhi and back, and two meals a day — the trips advertised at that price are usually 2 days on a shared Volvo with a basic room and no meals, which is a different product, not a cheaper version of this one. This package starts at ₹10,000 per person. If ₹5,000 is genuinely the budget, tell us: starting from Chandigarh, a simpler hotel or a bigger group all bring the per-head figure down, and we will show you what is actually possible at that number.

faqs.question: Is Rohtang Pass included in this Manali package?
faqs.answer: No. Rohtang needs a separate NGT permit with a strictly limited daily quota, is closed on Tuesdays for maintenance, and is shut by snow from roughly November to May. It can be added at extra cost when it is open and permits are available. Day 3 goes through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu instead, which is open nearly year-round and reaches the same high Lahaul landscape far more reliably.

faqs.question: What does a Manali tour package actually cost?
faqs.answer: This one starts at ₹10,000 per person on twin sharing, plus 5% GST — about ₹20,000 for a couple — covering 3 nights with breakfast and dinner and the private cab from Delhi and back. The figure moves with your travel dates, hotel category, group size and vehicle; 3★, 4★ and premium hotels are all available, and New Year and the May–June holidays are the dearest weeks of the year. Send us your dates and headcount and you will get an itemised quote.
